title: num_stages screening for N=16/K=256/one-warp packed NF4
status: rejected as a performance tuning knob; no whole-model strategy added
rowwise_singleton_equality: All stage=1/2/3 M=1/2 checks passed for q_proj and down_proj.
decision: num_stages=1 did not reduce registers, improve latency, or meaningfully change occupancy; do not add it to the runtime strategy.
limits: Finite operator measurement on one RTX 4050.
NCU durations are one profiled launch, not benchmark latency.
No whole-model equivalence or speed test was run for stage=1 because the operator screen showed no benefit.
